say:2:1530124402:1.text: They're invaders. They wanted our forest.
say:2:1530124402:1.source_cn: 他们是侵略者，为了抢占我们的森林。
say:2:1530124402:1.male: They're invaders. They wanted our forest.
say:2:1530124402:1.female: They're invaders. They wanted our forest.

say:3:1530124403:1.text: The Wildborn have no choice but to fight back with claws and spears!
say:3:1530124403:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔只能用利爪和长矛反击！
say:3:1530124403:1.male: The Wildborn have no choice but to fight back with claws and spears!
say:3:1530124403:1.female: The Wildborn have no choice but to fight back with claws and spears!
